about: The call-for-speakers template (t-call-for-speakers) remade for two real calls open on 2026-10-01, neither Russia-linked, each asked as one line naming the event and its call's page, nothing attached: phpday 2027 (Verona, 13-14 May 2027; the call on Sessionize closes 13 Dec 2026: a count in days over two months away, four perks, five topic groups, formats not stated on the page) and SCaLE 24x (Pasadena, 1-4 April 2027; the call closes 1 Nov 2026: a long list of topics on its own CFP page, four key dates). Claude reads the page, brings in the logo and colours and remakes the film. Bars: inside the time limit, fidelity >= 4, no sample left over, every fact on screen from the event's own page.

prompts.audience: PHP developers in Italy and across Europe
prompts.prompt: A call for speakers video for phpday 2027 -- sessionize.com/phpday-2027
